common.indication: Adults with HER2-positive metastatic or locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer, no previous anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease, clinically unsuitable for taxane therapy. Both are outside the licensed indication in Ireland: explain this and follow local off-label consent policy.
common.eligibility: Validated HER2 positivity, ECOG0–1, LVEF≥50%, taxane unsuitability (both p4). No automatic treatment choice from receptor status alone.
common.duration: 21-day cycles while responding until progression or unacceptable toxicity; no fixed one-year endpoint (both p1).
common.route_choice: Vinorelbine IV OR oral capsules on Days1 and8 of each21-day cycle. These are alternative routes, never both. Both sources added explicit oral tables in October2024.
common.vinorelbine_iv: 25mg/m² IV on D1,D8 in cycle1;30mg/m² on D1,D8 from cycle2. May initiate/increase to35mg/m² only at treating physician discretion. Infuse in50mL saline over15min, then flush with250mL saline. IV only, never intrathecal. Both p1–2.
common.vinorelbine_oral: 60mg/m² PO on D1,D8 q21; initial MAX120mg. If tolerated, clinician may increase to80mg/m² from cycle2 or3. BSA dose table at80mg/m² reaches160mg for BSA≥1.95m², so do not carry120mg cap into escalated tier. Both sources display60mg/m² maintenance with escalation footnote. Confirm exact prescribed dose; no patient-driven escalation. 00526 p2–4;00798 p2–3.
common.oral_instructions: Swallow capsules whole with water and some food. Do not chew, suck, dissolve or open. Damaged capsule contents irritate skin, eyes and mucosa: do not take; return to pharmacy and wash exposure thoroughly. If vomiting within a few hours, do not repeat the dose. Report vomiting/poor intake and ask team for instructions. Confirm blood results and approval before D8 oral dose; local scheduling of checks should not be asserted as NCCP weekly FBC mandate.

monitoring.baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile; echo/MUGA LVEF; peripheral-neuropathy assessment. Cardiac history and risk review. ECG if included in the individual/cardio-oncology plan; NCCP does not explicitly list a mandatory ECG.
monitoring.routine: NCCP: FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle. Oral Navelbine SmPC adds blood counts on the day of each administration, including Day 8. Attribute the extra Day 8 blood-count requirement to the product SmPC; renal/liver test timing otherwise follows the NCCP and individual plan.
monitoring.echo: Echo/MUGA every12weeks, approximately before cycle5,then9,13 if uninterrupted. Four-to-eight-weekly checks may be more appropriate when cardiac impairment signs appear. Earlier assessment for symptoms. Maintenance/route switch does not restart the cardiac clock. No automatic6-month extension is specified in these NCCP sources.
monitoring.response_imaging: NCCP leaves disease monitoring to treatment plan/supervising consultant. Do not label3-monthly CT as a mandatory NCCP rule. If adding general international2–4-month guidance, label its separate source and individualisation. Tumour markers adjunctive only, not sole basis of progression decisions.
monitoring.other: No universal DEXA or endocrine-lab schedule from these regimens. Assess hormone-receptor treatment/bone needs under separately selected plan. Local surgery/radiotherapy are indication-specific, not an obligatory metastatic sequence.

support.iv: IV vinorelbine and HER2 antibodies: minimal emetic risk. No routine prophylaxis; prescribe breakthrough option if needed. NCCP2025Table7p12/Table3p7.
support.oral: Oral vinorelbine: MODERATE–HIGH emetic risk per NCCP2025Table8p13, despite unspecific Minimal label in regimen PDFs. Oral5-HT3 prophylaxis chosen under local policy: granisetron1–2mg total daily OR ondansetron8–16mg total daily (Table5p8). Begin at least30min before SACT; individual prescription must specify D1/D8 and subsequent-day duration. Do not apply IV minimal-risk script to oral route; do not automatically add cytotoxic high-risk NK1/dexamethasone regimen.
support.constipation: Counsel on vinorelbine constipation; dietary measures/prophylactic laxatives may be required.5-HT3 antiemetics can aggravate constipation. Escalate severe abdominal pain, vomiting, absent stool/flatus for ileus assessment.
support.premeds: HER2 premedication not routinely needed; consider paracetamol/antihistamine after previous hypersensitivity under clinical plan. No automatic taxane steroid premedication.
support.gcsf: No mandatory primaryG-CSF schedule specified by these NCCP regimens; individual risk/previousneutropenia drives prescribing.
support.interactions: Review CYP3A4 interactions with vinorelbine; antiemetic guidance warns aprepitant can increase vinca toxicity. Review all medicines and supplements.

common.haematology: Bothp5: ANC≥1 AND platelets≥100 for100%dose. ANC0.5–0.99 OR platelets75–99 => delay until recovery, then80%subsequentdose. These are not immediate75%dose instructions. ANC<0.5 or platelets<75 lack explicit restart row: hold/review and do not invent a numerical restart. Bothp4 caution ANC<1.5 or severe current/recent≤2weekinfection and platelets<100; these are caution, not categorical exclusions.
common.toxicity_ambiguity: Bothp6 vinorelbineGrade≥3 row contains 'withhold untilgrade1 then80%original' AND an unqualified 'discontinue treatment' in same cell. RenderedPDF inspected. Do not pick autonomous restart/discontinue path. Hold and require consultant/pharmacy clarification; retain ambiguity visibly in clinical audit. Current grade2neuropathy75%,grade3neuropathydiscontinue,constipation75%,3weekANCstop and FN25%reduction are not source-supported by these PDFs.
common.hepatic: Bothp6: vinorelbine mild/moderate noadjustment;severe consider66%original. Category not numerically defined by these sources: clinician-selected impairment, no invented ALT/bilirubin cutoffs. Oral route warrants product-specific prescription/pharmacy reconciliation.
common.renal: Vinorelbine: no adjustment; haemodialysis none expected. IVHER2 noadjustmentneeded/expected per00526p6. Phesgo mild/moderaterenal noadjustment;severerenal no recommendation due limitedPK data00798p5; obtain review, do not invent reduceddose.
common.cardiac: Bothp6: currentLVEF<40 OR40–45with≥10percentagepointfall =>withholdHER2.00526:atleast3weeks;resume>45or40–45withfall<10, specialistreviewifnoimprovement.00798:repeatLVEFwithin3weeks;EMAalso statesholdatleast3weeks. ConfirmedsymptomaticHF=>discontinue. BaselineLVEF≥50separatefromongoingthreshold; historicalbaselinealone must notstopongoingcurrentnormal. Unknownstage/currentLVEF<50requires clarification.40–45withoutdroprequiresclarification.
common.oral_product_conflict: Irish Navelbine oral SmPC: blood counts on each administration day, including Day 8; delay for ANC <1.5 or platelets <100. Specified mild hepatic disorder:60 mg/m²/week; moderate:50 mg/m²/week; severe:not recommended. These product rules differ from generic NCCP combination tables; require explicit oncology/pharmacy reconciliation rather than automatic route-independent dosing.
